name: io.github.tonyyang0504/recruitee-mcp
description: Recruitee (jobs): search, apply. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_RECRUITEE_CAREERS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Careers Site API token generated by a Recruitee user of the company, sent as `X-Careers-Sites-Token`; 'Deadline for introducing the token to calls is 10 February 2027. Calls without the authorization header will return the 401 Unauthorized error'.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_RECRUITEE_COMPANY_SUBDOMAIN
environmentVariables.description: The company's Recruitee careers-site subdomain, e.g. 'recruiteedemo' in https://recruiteedemo.recruitee.com.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_RECRUITEE_APPLICANT_NAME
environmentVariables.description: Candidate full name sent as candidate.name by apply (required by Recruitee for applications).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_RECRUITEE_APPLICANT_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: Candidate e-mail sent as candidate.email by apply (required by Recruitee for applications).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_RECRUITEE_APPLICANT_PHONE
environmentVariables.description: Candidate phone sent as candidate.phone by apply (required unless the offer's form makes it optional).
